a.lede: After Nvidia's board accepted Jensen Huang's resignation as CEO, following reports that Huang had an affair with an alleged Chinese spy, President Donald Trump, too, appeared to submit to the new reality. Appearing on Stephen A. Smith's radio show shortly after the news came out, Trump said that Huang would "end up on his feet." […]
a.title: Trump engineered a risky comeback for Jensen Huang

b.lede: New York City mayor Zohran Mamdani weighed in on the corporate turbulence surrounding Nvidia and the chipmaker’s chief executive officer, Jensen Huang, saying he does not think working Americans 'signed up for their pensions being tied to the question of Huang’s fidelity to his marriage'. The mayor said Huang 'had a massive impact', with Nvidia’s share price dropping dramatically after
b.title: Mamdani questions AI economy as Jensen Huang returns to Nvidia – video
